|quote=<translate>A permanent power boost for evil-aligned fighters.</translate>
|Type=<translate>Character effect (buff)</translate>
|Source=<translate>Babidi, for evil-aligned players</translate>
|Duration=<translate>Permanent</translate>
|Effect=<translate>Power ×1.3; the Majin "M" on your character</translate>
}}
<translate>
The '''Majin Mark''' is the brand of the wizard [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi|Babidi]]. It gives you a '''permanent power boost''', ×1.3 by default, and puts the Majin "M" on your character. Only evil-aligned fighters can receive it.
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting the mark ==

Talk to Babidi in [[Special:MyLanguage/Babidi's Spaceship|Babidi's Ship]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]]) and choose '''Receive the Mark'''.

* You must be '''evil-aligned''': if your [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] is 39 or higher, Babidi refuses. Below that, he brands you.
* If you are already marked, he has nothing more to give you.
</translate>

<translate>
== Effect ==

* Your power is multiplied by ×1.3 by default: your Strength, Strike Power and Ki Power get the full bonus, and your defense gets half of it.
* The Majin "M" appears on your character.
* Once marked, the mark stays with you permanently.
</translate>
{{Config|General Server Config|majinPower}}

<translate>
== Commands ==

Admins can give or remove the mark with <code>/dmzeffect give majin -1 [targets]</code> and <code>/dmzeffect remove majin [targets]</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Effects#Commands|Effects]]).
</translate>
